title: Anti-automation (frontend, backend, Google reCAPTCHA v2)
description: Frontend renders the v2 checkbox widget (script https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api.js, site key from GET /api/options) and sends its token as recaptchaToken. Backend POSTs application/x-www-form-urlencoded {secret, response, remoteip} to RECAPTCHA_VERIFY_URL (default https://www.google.com/recaptcha/api/siteverify, 5 s timeout) and accepts only success=true. Test mode (SR-02): no network call; token 'test-pass' passes, anything else fails; the frontend shows a labelled test checkbox that yields 'test-pass'.
